description: This file contains definitions for difficulty level descriptions and a function to generate context-aware medical exam questions with detailed prompts and explanations for MCQ creation.

methods.name: get_generation_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for creating high-quality medical multiple-choice questions based on difficulty, context, and content type.

methods.name: get_validation_prompt
methods.description: Creates a prompt for reviewing and validating the quality and accuracy of a generated MCQ, including detailed scoring criteria.
